caption: The drawing depicts two separate dark brown to black metallic objects aligned vertically on a plain, off-white background. The object at the top appears to have a complex shape with a flat, rectangular lower section, some curved and rounded elements at the top, and a loop-like structure protruding above and to the right. Directly beneath it, and not touching, is a second elongated, narrow object resembling a blade or tapered bar, with one end flat and the other end pointed. The objects are centrally placed in the composition, with ample empty space surrounding them. The artist’s name, "EMILE CERO," is inscribed in small capital letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Spit
